company.label: Limited company
company.intro: Company accounts, corporation tax, annual registry filing, VAT, bookkeeping and director tax support in one monthly fee.

plans.strap: For newly formed, pre-trading or dormant companies.
features: Corporation Tax return (CT1) and CRO Annual Return (B1)

plans.name: LTD Starter
plans.strap: For new and small trading companies.

plans.limits: Up to 60 transactions / month · sales up to €400k · 3 directors

plans.name: LTD Scale

features: Cash businesses, RCT and group structures
plans.limits: Up to 120 transactions / month · sales up to €1m · 4 directors

sole-trader.label: Sole trader
sole-trader.intro: Straightforward bookkeeping and personal tax return support, with VAT and payroll included where the plan calls for it.

plans.strap: For people registering as self-employed and getting the finance side set up properly.
features: VAT, PAYE or RCT setup where needed
details: Business name registration guidance where relevant

plans.name: Sole Trader Essentials
plans.strap: For freelancers and newer self-employed clients.

plans.name: Sole Trader Plus
plans.strap: For busy sole traders with staff or card payments.
features: Payroll & PAYE for up to 2 employees
plans.limits: Up to 60 accounting transactions / month · turnover up to €200k

plans.name: Sole Trader Scale
plans.strap: For established self-employed businesses with higher activity.
plans.limits: Up to 150 accounting transactions / month · turnover up to €500k

contractor.label: Contractor
contractor.intro: Accounting packages for contractors, from first setup through to multi-contract and higher-complexity work.

plans.name: Contractor Plus
plans.strap: For contractors working across several contracts.
plans.limits: Up to 3 clients · standard contractor company setup

plans.name: Contractor Premium
